model.label: PyRUA-Dex
model.inputs: RGB cameras + proprioception + tactile + camera calibration + task description with goal text
model.trainingSetting: No human demonstration data and no weight updates: coding agents write and test controller programs on development layouts (seeds disjoint from the evaluation seeds); the best program per task is frozen
model.evaluationSetting: One frozen program per task; 26 tasks x 4 channels x 50 episodes; no language-model calls during evaluation

executionStepBudget.rule: 3 * ceil(1.5 * expert_time_step / 3) physics steps (the benchmark's own episode limit, 1x)

protocol.expertReference: paper-expert-reference (expert_time_step of the scene files at the benchmark commit)
protocolChanges: Method: one frozen program per task, written and tested by GPT-6 Astra coding agents on development layouts (seeds disjoint from the evaluation seeds, with the simulator's stage feedback). No human demonstration data, no trained weights, no language-model calls during evaluation.
Task description: the benchmark's instruction together with a goal text saying in words what completing the task means.

Inputs at evaluation: besides RGB cameras, joint positions and tactile, the program uses the episode's camera calibration, forward kinematics and a segmentation model (SAM3); no simulator state or success/stage signals.

aggregation.sr: 100 * successes / episodes per task/channel; equal channel mean per task; equal task mean over all 26 settings.
aggregation.lscr: 100 * mean episode latched_stage_completion_rate, including failures; equal channel mean per task; equal task mean over all 26 settings.
aggregation.efficiency: expert_time_step / mean successful steps_to_stable_success. Pool successful episodes across all four channels before calculating task mean efficiency. Overall values average task efficiencies over tasks with success; report valid-task counts.
aggregation.missing: null means unreported (NR). Efficiency without successes is null with no-success status. Valid-task counts are null when unreported, and 0 for an evaluated scope without successes.
aggregation.scope: Overall channel aggregates require all 26 settings. Four-channel means require all four channels. Never substitute Full-only scores for means or include duplicate reruns.
